Data files in your working directory: focus_billing.csv.

import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
print(df.columns.tolist())
print(df.SubAccountName.unique())
d=df[df.SubAccountName=='staging']
print(d.ChargePeriodStart.head())
m=d[d.ChargePeriodStart.astype(str).str.startswith('2026-09')]
print(len(m));print(m.groupby('ServiceName').BilledCost.sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(5))
